description: Use this when you need to decide whether a prospect is worth pushing a close on, needs nurturing, or should be let go. Scores six buying signals (filled spreadsheet, named dollar amount, budget authority, timeline under two weeks, urgent pain, warm intro) and returns a band with the specific next action. Do NOT use this to rank or judge people as human beings — it is a routing signal about deal readiness, and a low score means send something useful, not that the prospect is low quality. Do not use it to decide employment, credit, or anything outside a sales pipeline.

filledSpreadsheet.description: The prospect filled in the spreadsheet themselves.

namedAmount.description: The prospect named a specific dollar amount.

painIsUrgent.description: The pain is urgent, not a nice-to-have.

timelineUnderTwoWeeks.description: Decision timeline is under two weeks.

warmIntro.description: Came in through a warm introduction.
